name: Karaoke Neighbor
source:
Estell is a Californian delinquent who was just kicked out of her last school. Completely fed up with her behavior, her parents send her to Japan, her mother’s home country, to attend Namimori High.

She can’t get into any trouble there… right?

[From [url=https://lehxra.itch.io/karaoke-neighbor]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
埃斯特爾是加州的一個不良少女，剛剛被上一所學校開除。父母實在受夠了她的行為，把她送到母親的故國日本，就讀於並盛高中。

她在那兒總不能再惹什麼禍了……對吧？

［取自[url=https://lehxra.itch.io/karaoke-neighbor]itch.io[/url]］
